evidence.detail: Model method l(int) rotates every vertex for the requested angle, tracks exact min/max X/Y/Z values, then constructs rs/a/i from the three midpoint coordinates and three half-extents.
The X/Z half-extents are clamped to at least 32 and receive an additional 8 units when the model padding flag is set; the resulting object is cached by model angle for later render/picking use.

rs/a/i contains exactly six integer values with six direct getters, carries no unrelated state, and is the exact concrete implementation of rs/runelite/a/a, whose RuneLite API source identity is AABB.

proposals.note: ModelAABB is the corrected descriptive name for the exact six-int model-bounds implementation. The older R32 name AABB is superseded because exact upstream RuneLite source proves that AABB is the implemented API interface rs/runelite/a/a. Confidence remains 0.999.
